name: Akaneiro no Kyoukaisen
source:
One night, Shuu met the fox spirit Tomoe. In order to become a goddess, she must subdue the ‘tatari’ (curses) which devour all. Shuu’s hometown of Kanbe has been struck by these curses since some time, and despite the efforts of Tomoe and the half-youkai Kasumi, their numbers have only increased. Now Shuu’s kouhai Shion has also become targeted by them. In order to protect his hometown and those precious to him, Shuu joined the fight against the tatari. As they cross the line between the human and demon worlds, the world becomes dyed madder red.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/06/01/june-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一天晚上，修遇见了狐精巴。为了成为女神，她必须制服吞噬一切的“tatari”（诅咒）。修的故乡神边自一段时间以来就一直受到这些诅咒的影响，尽管巴和半妖怪霞做出了努力，但他们的人数却只增不减。现在Shuu的后海紫苑也成为了他们的目标。为了保护家乡和自己珍视的人，修加入了对抗鞑靼的战斗。当他们跨越人界和魔界的界线时，世界被染成了茜红色。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2017/06/01/june-2017-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
